title: SWF: DefineText (tag 11) for static text fields
description: Static text (textType='static') in Flash 8 should use DefineText (tag 11) rather than DefineEditText (tag 37). DefineText renders text as vector-like glyphs at runtime, matching Flash 8 behavior. The DefineText format: CharacterId, TextBounds RECT, TextMatrix MATRIX, GlyphBits (UI8), AdvanceBits (UI8), then TEXTRECORD array. Each TEXTRECORD has optional style changes (font/color/xOffset/yOffset) then glyph entries (index+advance pairs). Implement encodeDefineText() in packages/swf/src/text.ts, selecting it for textType='static' in compile.ts. Fall back to DefineEditText for dynamic/input. Add 6 tests.
